Guessed https://electionresults.sos.ms.gov/ (in case of a vendor election-night site): the host name does not resolve.

Two web searches for a Mississippi Secretary of State election-night reporting site: none found. News coverage of the still-uncalled 2026 US Senate race says the same thing from the other side: WGCU/NPR, 2026-11-06 (https://www.wgcu.org/2026-11-06/no-one-knows-how-many-ballots-are-outstanding-in-mississippis-senate-race) reports counties are 'not required to transmit election results to the state until next week', and quotes Secretary of State Watson that 'the individual counties will be the best source of the latest and most up-to-date information' (quotes as returned by a fetch-and-summarize tool; I did not read the article's raw text).

A search summary also described a 2020 Secretary of State statement that the office would not announce unofficial results and would post only certified county results (given as https://www.sos.ms.gov/node/908). I fetched that URL and today it is an unrelated page, so that statement is unverified.

Conclusion: the state office publishes no live statewide count; election-night numbers come from the 82 counties (and from news organizations' tallies of them). Confidence is medium rather than high because this is an absence finding: I checked the office's results index and searched, but could not prove no unlinked page exists.
